clips.title: The story
paras: Downstream is a quest in eastern Elwynn Forest tasked by Ormin Pelford at Eastvale Logging Camp. After Ormin's wagon accidentally overturns into the river, adventurers are asked to brave murlocs and wolves downstream to recover waterlogged timber supplies.

While transporting a shipment of gear back from a local trading post, laborer Ormin Pelford suffered a mishap when his wagon tipped over along the waterway near Eastvale Logging Camp. The cargo tumbled into the current and was quickly swept downstream before he could secure it. Without these vital woodworking tools, the loggers face delays in their timber operations.

Retrieving the waterlogged cargo is complicated by the hazardous local wildlife. Aggressive murlocs claim the muddy shoals downstream, while predatory wolves roam the surrounding woods. Unable to fend off these threats alone, Ormin relies on hardy travelers to braze the riverbanks, salvage the submerged saw, axe, and toolbox, and bring them back safely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.
Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort - do you think you could find them for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You look a bit damp, friend. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.
